correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive n and all k>=2, every additive relation between two sums in the separated-run representation is coordinatewise, because the lowest nonzero discrepancy has magnitude less than the gap to the next run. Thus every k-AP corresponds to a tuple of interval k-APs. Oriented intervals contribute exactly B_i and constant sequences contribute prod L_i; reversal halves the remainder. Maximum-length and no-three-term/Fibonacci consequences follow algebraically. An independent direct checker passed 8192 finite pairs plus extremal and Fibonacci checks; its finite scope is not relied on as proof.
